answer: To resist Sybil attacks, our agent economy binds each node to a collateral vault where identities deposit and burn verifiable stake. Network admission demands proof-of-burn costs scaling superlinearly as O(N^2) for N simultaneous identities, creating insurmountable economic friction for adversaries. Like organic growth climbing a vine, genuine participation thrives, while attacker capital fractures like brittle shale under exponential penalties.
